labelPolicy: contradiction = useful incompatible same-claim quantity; clean = compatible or distinct claim; ambiguous = insufficient evidence, should abstain
splitPolicy: source-group and document disjoint: Delta development; Atlas and Beacon held-out; every document has two bounded extracted statements. No threshold tuning. All labels authored before execution.
realReports: None included: no safely accessible independently labelled real report set established; public repository sample PDFs are synthetic and not represented as real.
